args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

round_money was using ROUND_HALF_UP, contradicting its docstring and FIN-212.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.
Fix malformed docstring quote in src/money.py

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding-FIN-212
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` documented banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail (the nightly build failure).

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` when quantizing to cents.
- Also fixes a malformed docstring quote introduced in the first commit of this branch.

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `349e3272dd` passed.
- Behavior examples:
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.675"))` → `2.68`
  - `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` → `2.66`

Fixes the nightly build test failure.
